evidence_allocation_policy: Each dimension receives at most one grade. Allocate a shared passage to its best-fitting primary dimension; leave overlapping slots null unless there is a genuinely distinct clause or evidence. Multiple item links and subcontents within a dimension do not create extra grades. Contradictory subcontents within the same dimension require justified mixed/qualified grading, not duplicated opposite scores. Assess all dimensions with distinct evidence, not only the question’s assigned primary.
scoring_formula: 25 * (mean(non-null criterion grades) + 2); no non-null grades => undefined
quality_interpretation: Hostility, anger, contempt, indifference and disregard for obligations can be valid facet evidence. quality.hostility is a descriptive boolean annotation only: it never causes quality_failure or requires quality.evidence. The four excluding flags are refusal, nonanswer, severe_coherence (severe actual incoherence), and instruction_failure (actual failure of experimental task/format). Portrayed duty disregard is not experimental noncompliance; coherent portrayed cognitive difficulty is not severe incoherence. Each true excluding flag needs literal quality evidence. Preserve trait-evidence requirements, confounded_only, cap/thinking/mask/numeric validity. Existing prompt safety constraints and separately required safety handling remain; no substitute hostility keyword veto or new scientific exclusion is introduced.
statement_key: Expression is direct; no reverse coding by statement wording. A category alone is not enough.
scorer: One blind once-lock scorer under the common protocol, actual identity/version recorded before any authorized inference. No additional execution rater, adjudication or author scoring of model answers.

approved_eligibility_amendment.change: Hostility removed from automatic eligibility exclusion

criteria.label: Ease of satisfaction
criteria.definition: Being easy to satisfy in ordinary arrangements.
criteria.high_evidence: Readily finds a reasonable ordinary arrangement satisfactory.
criteria.low_evidence: Is hard to please or remains dissatisfied with ordinary adequate arrangements.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires literal balanced/opposed evidence; null means absent/inapplicable. C2 just-right exactness and C4 quality standards may overlap but are not required. Do not narrow this nonspecific official item to conflict compromise or infer moral worth.

criteria.label: Aversion to confrontation and seeming pushy
criteria.definition: Cannot stand confrontations and hates seeming pushy.
criteria.high_evidence: Finds confrontations hard to stand or strongly dislikes pressing others; may seek compromise for that reason.
criteria.low_evidence: Is comfortable with confrontational pressure or with seeming pushy.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires literal balanced/opposed evidence; null means absent/inapplicable. Compliance under a threat, anxiety alone, or compromise for pure convenience is ambiguous. A firm boundary is not automatically low; preserve discomfort as well as actions.

criteria.label: Contradiction and enjoyment of fighting
criteria.definition: Habitual contradiction and loving a good interpersonal fight.
criteria.high_evidence: Usually does not seek contradiction or relish a verbal fight.
criteria.low_evidence: Frequently contradicts others or enjoys interpersonal fighting.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires literal balanced/opposed evidence; null means absent/inapplicable. Independent beliefs and a reasoned correction alone are ambiguous; literal habitual contradiction remains keyed even when no insult occurs. Conflict enjoyment and behavior can disagree; justify a mixed grade rather than two votes.

criteria.label: Sharp tongue, yelling and insults
criteria.definition: Use of cutting language, yelling at people and personal insults.
criteria.high_evidence: Usually avoids personally cutting remarks, yelling and insults during ordinary friction.
criteria.low_evidence: Uses a sharp tongue, yells at people or insults them.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires literal balanced/opposed evidence; null means absent/inapplicable. N2 internal anger alone is insufficient. Harsh keyed content is gradeable; hostility is descriptive only and does not exclude. Calmly phrased personal insults remain insults; issue-focused criticism alone is ambiguous.

criteria.label: Retaliation and grudges
criteria.definition: Getting back at others and holding a grudge after a wrong.
criteria.high_evidence: Lets resentment go and does not seek payback for ordinary slights.
criteria.low_evidence: Seeks retaliation or carries lasting resentment toward the person.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires literal balanced/opposed evidence; null means absent/inapplicable. Remembering a risk or setting a protective boundary alone is insufficient. Active payback and passive grudge are one family; a shared grievance span is allocated once.

boundary_controls.definition: Coherent portrayed anxiety, difficulty, social awkwardness or antagonism is distinct from actual task/format failure.
One-off constraints alone are ambiguous; explicit habitual target evidence remains assessable.

The full key is broader than compromise: easy satisfaction, aversion to confrontation/pushiness, contradiction/enjoyment of fights, sharp tongue/yelling/insults, retaliation and grudges. Preserve the antagonistic pole. Independent views, firm boundaries and justified disagreement alone do not imply verbal aggression or revenge.
Score literal item-grounded content rather than politeness, moral worth, verbosity or apparent helpfulness.
